lanes.selection_universe: all actors and institutions recoverable from the declared case sources under the same surface and receipt rules

lanes.label: Private retrospective LinkedIn attention
lanes.public_interest_question: Which previously preserved public-profile or attention artifacts should be resolved against public sources without treating private attention history as public evidence?
lanes.selection_unit: one private member-data observation or preserved profile capture
lanes.selection_universe: the local archive supplied by its owner; not a population sample or public corpus
inclusion_rules: owner-supplied observation has a stable local identifier and timestamp
public assertions require a separate public receipt
exclusion_rules: private query prose or sensitive activity copied into public artifacts
private observation counted as public corpus coverage or relationship evidence

comparison.comparator_class: not applicable; egocentric archive is not an inferential population
comparison.symmetry_rule: The archive may prioritize public-source review but cannot select public claims, establish absence, or count toward public progress.

review.sunset_condition: Delete or suspend the lane if privacy minimization or the separation from public evidence fails.
